# Wogopogo

> Wogopogo is a free, moderated job board for the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada. It connects local employers directly with job seekers and does not handle applications.

## Public resources

- [Browse current Okanagan jobs](https://wogopogo.ca/): Search approved, unexpired local job listings.
- [Post an Okanagan job](https://wogopogo.ca/post): Submit a local job listing for moderation at no charge.
- [Current public URLs](https://wogopogo.ca/sitemap.xml): Live XML sitemap containing the homepage, posting page, and every approved, unexpired job listing.

## Coverage

Wogopogo covers communities from Osoyoos through Salmon Arm, including Kelowna, West Kelowna, Lake Country, Vernon, Penticton, Summerland, Peachland, Oliver, and nearby Okanagan communities.

Individual job pages use stable URLs in the form `https://wogopogo.ca/job/{id}`. Only approved and unexpired listings are public or included in the sitemap.
